summary: Manage Excel Links now checks every linked workbook when it opens and shows a Status column: a yellow Needs Review icon marks a dataset or DFM method whose workbook was saved after its linked values were last loaded.
details: The check compares the workbook's saved time with the dataset's data file or the DFM method file, the same rule the Dataset window applies when it opens; a workbook the server cannot open leaves the cell blank.
The status line under the table counts the references that need review, and the column filters like every other.
